summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-typescript preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script that runs setup.mjs, which detects platform and architecture, downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods it, then invokes a bundled math_init.js with that downloaded interpreter. math_init.js is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated file (string-array cipher, mangled identifiers, shift-rotator decoder) shipped in a package whose declared purpose is providing an ESLint TypeScript configuration; it is not referenced by index.js and has no relation to eslint configuration. setup.mjs itself uses obfuscator.io-style transforms (hex-mangled identifiers, per-function string dictionaries wrapping fs/https/os/path/zlib imports and calls like execFileSync). Installing the package causes an alternate language runtime to be fetched and used to execute an obfuscated bundled payload on the installer's host before any code review, giving the publisher arbitrary code execution on every installer machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
